title.en: Remove the secret key from the script "www.example-shop.com/assets/app.js"

why.en: A Supabase secret key was found in a script that any visitor can download. Anyone who reads it can use the key.
why.ur: Ek Supabase secret key aisi script mein mili jise har visitor download kar sakta hai. Jo bhi use parhe wo key istemal kar sakta hai.

steps.en: Rotate the key now: in Supabase go to API keys, create a new secret key and delete the old one.
steps.ur: Key abhi rotate karein: Supabase -> API keys mein nayi secret key banayein aur purani delete karein.

steps.en: Remove the key from your code and from any env file that is built into the site. Use it only on a server.
steps.ur: Key ko apne code se aur us env file se hatayein jo site mein build hoti hai. Ise sirf server par istemal karein.

steps.en: Redeploy the site, so the old script is replaced.
steps.ur: Site redeploy karein, taake purani script badal jaye.

steps.en: Run the audit again to check that the key is gone.
steps.ur: Audit dobara chalayein aur dekhein ke key ab nahi hai.

why.en: Rows of this table that belong to one user could be reached by someone else in the test.
why.ur: Is table ki jo rows ek user ki hain, test mein unhein koi aur dekh ya badal sakta tha.

steps.en: Open finding fnd_001 in the report and read the suggested fix.
steps.ur: Report mein finding fnd_001 kholein aur suggest kiya gaya fix parhein.

steps.en: Read the SQL, then run it in the Supabase SQL editor of your TEST project.
steps.ur: SQL parhein, phir use apne TEST project ke Supabase SQL editor mein chalayein.

steps.en: Press "Approve fix" to record your decision.
steps.ur: Apna faisla likhne ke liye "Approve fix" dabayein.

steps.en: Press "Re-test" and check that the table is no longer a leak.
steps.ur: "Re-test" dabayein aur dekhein ke table ab leak nahi raha.

why.en: Without this header a browser may still try plain http for your site.
why.ur: Is header ke baghair browser ab bhi aapki site ke liye seedha http aazma sakta hai.

steps.en: Send the header "Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" from your host or server.
steps.ur: Apne host ya server se header "Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" bhejein.

steps.en: Run the audit again to see the header.
steps.ur: Header dekhne ke liye audit dobara chalayein.

why.en: The browser has no rule about where scripts may come from, so a script injected by someone else would run.
why.ur: Browser ke paas ye rule nahi ke scripts kahan se aa sakti hain, isliye kisi aur ki dali hui script chal jayegi.

steps.en: Start with a simple policy such as "default-src 'self'" and allow only the places your site really loads scripts from.
steps.ur: Sada policy se shuru karein, jaise "default-src 'self'", aur sirf wahi jagahein allow karein jahan se aapki site sach mein scripts leti hai.

steps.en: Send it as the Content-Security-Policy header, test the site, then run the audit again.
steps.ur: Ise Content-Security-Policy header ke taur par bhejein, site test karein, phir audit dobara chalayein.

title.en: Confirm that table "hotels" is meant to be like this
title.ur: Tasdeeq karein ke table "hotels" aisa hi hona chahiye

why.en: The checks could not tell whether this table is a problem. It may be public on purpose, or it could not be tested.
why.ur: Checks nahi bata sake ke ye table masla hai ya nahi. Ho sakta hai ye jaan boojh kar public ho, ya iska test na ho saka ho.

steps.en: Decide whether everyone may read this table (for example a public hotel list).
steps.ur: Faisla karein ke is table ko har koi parh sakta hai ya nahi (jaise public hotel list).

steps.en: If it holds private data, add a row-level security rule, then run a re-test.
steps.ur: Agar isme private data hai to row-level security ka rule lagayein, phir re-test chalayein.

why.en: Without it a browser may pass the full address of your pages to other sites.
why.ur: Iske baghair browser aapke pages ka poora address doosri sites ko de sakta hai.

steps.en: Send the header "Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin" from your host or server.
steps.ur: Apne host ya server se header "Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin" bhejein.

title.ur: Theek karne ke baad re-test karein

why.en: A re-test runs the same checks again and shows whether each fix worked.
why.ur: Re-test wohi checks dobara chalata hai aur dikhata hai ke har fix kaam kar gaya ya nahi.

steps.en: Press "Re-test" and enter the keys of your TEST project again (they are never stored).
steps.ur: "Re-test" dabayein aur apne TEST project ki keys dobara dein (wo kabhi save nahi hotin).
